sentences.japanese: 空港は霧のために閉鎖された。
sentences.english: The airport was closed because of the fog.

sentences.japanese: 運転手は霧で信号がよく見えなかった。
sentences.english: The driver could not distinguish the signal in the fog.

sentences.japanese: 雨と霧のために湖の美しい景色を楽しむことができなかった。
sentences.english: The beautiful scene of the lake couldn't be enjoyed because of the rain and fog.

sentences.japanese: ロンドンは霧で有名だ。
sentences.english: London is famous for its fog.

sentences.japanese: ロンドンはもはや霧の都ではない。
sentences.english: London is no longer a city of fog.
